patterns.note: Content sections are structured with a large, sequential number (01, 02, etc.) as a primary visual anchor, followed by a heading, descriptive text, and a large, detailed image, often with text on the left and image on the right.
A strong typographic hierarchy uses oversized, bold sans-serif headings for main titles, with a vibrant orange accent color highlighting key words, contrasted with smaller, lighter weight body text.

The site employs a dominant dark theme (black/very dark gray) as a background, with bright orange serving as the sole vibrant accent color for call-to-action elements, highlighted text, and full-bleed separator sections.

As the user scrolls, the initial top announcement banner disappears, and the main navigation bar shrinks in height and gains a solid background. Content sections, including their large numerical identifiers, reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
A recurring 'Check Our Latest News' section presents articles in a grid of cards, each featuring a small image, title, and 'READ MORE' link, maintaining the dark theme and orange accent.

technique_notes: A deep dark background is used across most sections, with a vibrant orange serving as a primary accent for key textual elements, call-to-action buttons, and full-bleed separator sections.

The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport. Upon scrolling past the initial hero content, it slightly reduces its vertical padding and gains a solid background to maintain readability over diverse content.

Sections and their content, including large numerical identifiers and descriptive text blocks, are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the user's viewport, orchestrated using GSAP ScrollTrigger.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, lighter weight body text and uppercase labels for navigation and subheadings.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; buttons and input fields have a very slight rounding, almost sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; sections have generous vertical padding, while content within sections is well-spaced but not overly dense, especially in the hero.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, sequential numbering (01, 02, 03, 04) as a primary visual element to segment and introduce complex product categories is unique. This, combined with the stark dark theme and vibrant orange accent, creates a highly structured yet visually impactful presentation that feels both technical and authoritative.
